posts.author: Sam Dykstra
posts.text: If Ohtani is the corresponding move and De Paula’s coming up to DH, then the defense point is moot. Ease him into the Majors by letting him do what he does best — hit.
posts.jp: 大谷翔平が対応する動きであり、デパウラがDHで上がってくるなら、守備のポイントは関係ない。彼が最も得意なことである打撃をさせることで、メジャーへ段階的に引き上げよう。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: The Guardians lost, so the #BlueJays remain 1.0 game back. If anyone wants to go to the postseason, the third AL Wild Card spot is kind of just sitting there.

reply_texts.text: I'm sure the White Sox will eventually be fighting for it too; there a non zero chance the Jays will finish with more wins than the central and the west champs which is insane
reply_texts.author: johnquissy.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: The least hardest push ever seen in the AL

reply_texts.text: You even get to play a team that will likely have a worse record than the 1st or 2nd wildcard teams! Anyone?
reply_texts.author: davethecamel.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Sure wish the jays wanted that spot
reply_texts.author: northbaymoe.bsky.social

posts.jp: ガーディアンズが敗れたため、ブルージェイズは1ゲーム差のままだ。ポストシーズンに行きたいなら、AL第3ワイルドカード枠はそこにある。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Phillies were down 4-0, 6-4 and now lead, 11-6. Braves and Cubs both down big, too. Interesting.
posts.jp: フィリーズは0-4、4-6と下回っていたが、今は11-6でリード。ブレーブスもカブスも大きく下回っている。興味深い。

reply_texts.author: pfholden.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Great morning read, thanks for sharing! Currently at 8/30 and this helped solidify the path a bit more.
reply_texts.author: soroks.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: A lot depends on who your favorite team is. My first Dodger game was at the Coliseum in LA in 1961, after that I went to several Dodger games each year. I've been to only six other stadiums but for me Dodger Stadium holds all the great memories with my dad, and later with my kids.
reply_texts.author: oldergamers.bsky.social

reply_texts.text:
I visited Fenway for the first time this year and it was great, the staff especially. But it's fully enclosed and offers no real views beyond its walls. That's a huge knock against it. 

My bigger gripe is why are you doing Camden dirty during this miserable year of Baltimore baseball?

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: In MLB history, there have been 17 such seasons from a center fielder accomplished by 8 players: Willie Mays (4x), Mickey Mantle (3x), Ty Cobb (3x), Aaron Judge (2x), Mike Trout (2x), Stan Musial, Tris Speaker, Pete Crow-Armstrong.
posts.jp: MLB史上、センターフィルダーによるそのようなシーズンは17度あり、8選手が達成：ウィリー・メイズ(4度)、ミッキー・マントル(3度)、タイ・コッブ(3度)、アーロン・ジャッジ(2度)、マイク・トラウト(2度)、スタン・ミュージアル、トリス・スピーカー、ピート・クロウ・アームストロング。

posts.text: Astros 2, Phillies 1. That's the second game in five days the Phillies have lost with Jhoan Duran pitching. They wasted another strong Zack Wheeler outing.
